  PROBLEM: AI_ENGINE_CLAUDE_NO_WEB_NOTE phrase "When one the task depends on is not there" is grammatically incomplete (missing "that" or "a fact").
  WHY: The model will likely parse it correctly from context, but it is a small quality issue. Suggested fix: "When one that the task depends on is not there" or "When a fact the task depends on is not there" (1 line).
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:407-427 | HARDENING (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1)
  PROBLEM: _ai_engine_instructions_file creates a new mktemp copy under RUNNER_TEMP on each call that is never deleted on the success path.
  WHY: Multiple Claude runs in the same job accumulate copies. Cleanup would touch three callers' existing traps. The runner cleans RUNNER_TEMP per job, so this is not a leak. Suggested fix: a `trap 'rm -f "${_AI_ENGINE_TMP_INSTRUCTIONS:-}"' RETURN` in each caller (about 3 lines), which can ship in a follow-up.
